Maya: :wave: Quick morning relay — I'm taking primary for the next 12h (UTC-7). Chris R is secondary. Olivia T is covering async follow-ups and will handle the postmortem doc.
Maya: Yesterday we saw 3 pages for high kv-cache miss rates that correlated with elevated token latency for a small subset of customers. Incident resolved by toggling the cache warming job and rolling back the last quantized runtime rolling deploy.
incident-bot: INCIDENT 2026-03-14-015: kv-cache-thundering - 3 pages -> resolved at 1769498400. Impact: increased 95th latency for /v1/generate on dedicated pools in us-west-2 for ~27 minutes. Severity: Sev2. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache>
Chris R: Summary of what I saw on the page — cache eviction spikes coincided with a heavy tail of long-context calls from account: acme-corp-prod. The autoscaler briefly ramped up but didn't warm the suffix keys fast enough.
Olivia T: I collected the logs and pasted the relevant snippet below. Not pretty but useful.
Olivia T: ```
2026-03-14T02:13:10Z cache-manager WARN evict: tenant=acme-corp-prod evicted=1200 rate=220/sec
2026-03-14T02:13:11Z proxy ERROR backpressure: route=/v1/generate p95=1240ms p99=2350ms
2026-03-14T02:13:30Z warm-job INFO started batch_id=42 targets=128
```
Maya: What we did: 1) paused the newest quantized runtime rollout, 2) increased warm-job concurrency from 8 -> 24, 3) temporarily bumped the per-tenant cache size for acme-corp-prod. Those three actions brought p95 back to normal.
Chris R: Current status: all traces green for the affected routes. Autoscaler metrics show normal CPU/GPU utilization. No active pagers.
Maya: Open action items before I sign off:
- Olivia to write postmortem skeleton and data (owner: Olivia T) — due EOD
- Chris to add a quick synthetic that exercises long-context path for top 10 tenants (owner: Chris R) — due tomorrow morning
- Ops to add a safeguard in the autoscaler to pre-warm cache on scale-up (owner: infra-team) — backlog ticket created
Olivia T: Noting a coverage gap: I'm on PTO Fri morning (UTC). We don't currently have an APAC overnight backup for that slot — need someone volunteer or we add temporary overrides to escalation.
Maya: Good catch. @chris, can you cover APAC overlap Fri 00:00-08:00 PT? If not, we'll page infra on-call to cover the warm-job tuning window.
Chris R: I can take the first 4 hours, but have a call at 04:30 PT. If nobody else volunteers, I'll set up automations to escalate to infra after 05:00 PT.
Maya: Notes for whoever takes APAC night: runbook link for quick checks: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache#quick-checks> key commands:
```
# check recent cache evictions
redwoodctl metrics query "cache.evictions{tenant=acme-corp-prod}" --last 30m
# tail proxy errors
kubetail proxy -c proxy --since 15m | grep "backpressure"
```
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-14T02:00:00Z: rolled runtime v2.9.7 -> v2.9.8 (quantized) to 10% of dedicated pools — paused after feedback.
Maya: Customer impact: small set of dedicated customers saw elevated latency; no data loss. Outreach: support already reached out to top-5 affected accounts; CS tracking ticket 7892.
Olivia T: Postmortem plan: will include timeline, metrics, root cause hypothesis (cache warm-job throughput + rollout timing), mitigation steps we took, and action owners. I will add a section for 'how to avoid' with suggested changes to autoscaler and rollout phasing.
Chris R: Small recommended tweak for the runbook: add an immediate mitigation step to temporarily increase warm-job concurrency — saved us time yesterday.
Maya: OK. If no further pages pop up, I'll hand off to @chris in ~2h. Please ack here when you see this thread and add any missing action items.
Chris R: ack. I'll take primary at handoff and cover the APAC overlap for 4h. I'll file the autoscaler pre-warm ticket.
Olivia T: ack. I'll start the postmortem doc and drop the link when it's ready. Also adding synthetic tests to my todo.
Maya: Thanks team — :white_check_mark: leaving notes in the incident board. If anyone wants to rehearse the runbook steps later, ping me.
